name: The Pig at Harlyn Bay
accommodation: 30 bedrooms in the main house and Stonehouse, including four Garden Wagons
beachAccess: A short stroll from Harlyn Beach and Constantine Bay beaches (Visit Cornwall)
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant, bar, seasonal Lobster Shed, kitchen garden, Potting Shed treatments, lounges with open fires, WiFi
overview: A characterful country house hotel at Harlyn Bay, a few minutes from Constantine Bay and about ten minutes' drive from Padstow. Rooms are spread between the main house, a stone courtyard building and four wagons in the gardens. The restaurant serves Cornish produce, much of it from the hotel's own kitchen garden.
surfTripFit: Within easy reach of both Harlyn and Constantine Bay, so you can choose whichever beach is working best.
